# truenas_privilege (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS privilege by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Privilege name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `builtin_name` (String) Internal name of the built-in privilege if this is a system privilege (e.g. "LOCAL_ADMINISTRATOR"); null for custom privileges.
- `ds_groups` (List of Number) GIDs of directory-service groups whose members gain this privilege.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the privilege.
- `local_groups` (List of Number) GIDs of local groups whose members gain this privilege.
- `roles` (List of String) Role names included in this privilege.
- `web_shell` (Boolean) Whether members of the assigned groups may log in to the web shell.
